svg.title: Méditerranée
svg.desc: Schematic visual study after the cited photograph. Approximate geometry and standardized colors; wall and cast shadows omitted. Nine colored rectangles after museum reproduction, geometry corroborated with MoMA1973 plate. Three relief panels represented flat; no invented shadows. Physical dimensions are historical caption inch conversions, not current Tate measurement.
